video_title: Full Denver Nuggets Postgame Media Availability vs. CHI 🎙

quotes.speaker: Coach Adelman
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Adelman on defensive challenges against Chicago's three-point shooting
quotes.excerpt: they shot the hell out of the three, and then we had a hard time stopping the ball.
quotes.quote: They shot the hell out of the three, and then we had a hard time stopping the ball. They got to the paint. When you're shooting the ball that well, guys were in between when they could help, when they couldn't. They had that many guys make a three. It was a really tough night for us guarding them, and obviously on the other end, we did a lot of really good things.
quotes.social_post: Coach Adelman on the defensive struggles against Chicago: They shot the hell out of the three and we had a hard time stopping the ball. It was a really tough night for us guarding them.

structured.context: Coach Adelman discusses the defensive difficulties the Nuggets faced against the Chicago Bulls three-point shooting.

quotes.speaker: Coach Adelman
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Adelman on team resilience and winning close games
quotes.excerpt: I give Buddy Hield a ton of credit, Jalen Smith. These guys, they played great.
quotes.quote: You have to understand it's the NBA. If we could win 130 to 60 every night, we would do it. But I'm pretty sure we won the game, just like we've won some low-scoring games like the Boston game. All these games are different, they're their own story. I give Buddy Hield a ton of credit, Jalen Smith. These guys, they played great. They really did, and Giddey was incredible getting in the paint and making plays.
quotes.social_post: Coach Adelman on winning close games: You have to understand it is the NBA. If we could win 130 to 60 every night we would do it. All these games are different, they are their own story.

structured.context: Coach Adelman reflects on the team win and praises the performance of specific opposing players.

quotes.speaker: Coach Adelman
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Adelman on Aaron Gordon's aggressive fourth-quarter performance
quotes.excerpt: I was trying to force-feed him the ball. I had to get him going, get his rhythm going.
quotes.quote: I was trying to force-feed him the ball. I had to get him going, get his rhythm going. The cool thing was I thought he got himself going. I think he was under the impression he got hit on a play, and I thought the very next play he was so super aggressive. He got to the rim, got the steal to your point, and kind of got us going.
quotes.social_post: Coach Adelman on Aaron Gordon's fourth quarter: I was trying to force feed him the ball to get his rhythm going. I thought he got himself going and he was so super aggressive.

structured.context: Coach Adelman explains his strategy to get Aaron Gordon involved offensively during the fourth quarter.

quotes.speaker: Coach Adelman
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Adelman on offensive fluidity and trusting open shots
quotes.excerpt: it's so much easier to have fluidity if guys shoot when they're open.
quotes.quote: It's so much easier to have fluidity if guys shoot when they're open. If you're waiting for something to happen with a 24-second clock, you're in trouble. I just think the guys have owned that. Jamal Murray has to take the open shot when it's available and we create it. Same thing with Nikola Jokic. It just helps our offense throughout, and 35 threes for us is a lot, so it was good to see us get them up.
quotes.social_post: Coach Adelman on offensive fluidity: It is so much easier to have fluidity if guys shoot when they are open. If you are waiting for something to happen with a 24 second clock you are in trouble.

structured.context: Coach Adelman emphasizes the importance of Jamal Murray and Nikola Jokic taking open shots to maintain offensive fluidity.

quotes.speaker: Nikola Jokic
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jokic on slowing down the game and controlling the pace
quotes.excerpt: we had the opportunity to slow down the game and we were kind of walking into the flow.
quotes.quote: We had the opportunity to slow down the game and we were kind of walking into the flow. They were dictating the tempo of the game. I think there was a chance for us to slow down because Coach Adelman always says the quick offers equal equal quick, strict defense, and like if you have a longer offer, they're going to play a longer defense too.
quotes.social_post: Nikola Jokic on pace: We had the opportunity to slow down the game and we were kind of walking into the flow. They were dictating the tempo of the game.

structured.context: Nikola Jokic discusses the team's struggle to control the pace of the game against the opponent.

quotes.speaker: Nikola Jokic
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jokic on chemistry and playing with Jamal Murray
quotes.excerpt: we have been playing for so long together, I don't even think it's taking turns.
quotes.quote: We have been playing for so long together, I don't even think it's taking turns. It just happens, you know? You're trying to get open, if you don't get the ball, it's okay. You're trying to set a screen, if you get, you know, it's just happening and we just try to react and you just try to score in those moments.
quotes.social_post: Nikola Jokic on his chemistry with Jamal Murray: We have been playing for so long together, I do not even think it is taking turns. It just happens, you know? We just try to react.

structured.context: Nikola Jokic describes the natural chemistry and flow of playing alongside Jamal Murray.

quotes.speaker: Jamal Murray
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamal Murray on closing out games on the road
quotes.excerpt: I just think we executed down the stretch and locked in on defense.
quotes.quote: I just think we executed down the stretch and locked in on defense and just made whatever shot they're going to take tough, even though they still made some tough ones. Just staying with it, especially on the road. Got to nip the runs in the bud, and I think we did a good job of just reacting to those.
quotes.social_post: Jamal Murray on closing out road games: We executed down the stretch and locked in on defense. Got to nip the runs in the bud, and I think we did a good job of just reacting to those.

structured.context: Jamal Murray explains how the team focused on defensive execution to close out the game on the road.

quotes.speaker: Jamal Murray
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamal Murray on Nikola Jokic's consistency and resilience
quotes.excerpt: he struggled for maybe seven games shooting, and he was still having 21, 22 and 13.
quotes.quote: No one's worried about him. I just think he struggled for maybe seven games shooting, and he was still having 21, 22 and 13. So, I mean, it's not really, I wouldn't consider that a struggle. It's just good to see him have his flow and be as dominant as we know he can be, and I mean, it's every night he's doing this. So, if he misses a couple shots for one day, we're not, we're not tripping.
quotes.social_post: Jamal Murray on Nikola Jokic: No one is worried about him. He struggled for maybe seven games shooting, and he was still having 21, 22 and 13. I would not consider that a struggle.

structured.context: Jamal Murray defends Nikola Jokic's recent shooting performance and highlights his consistent overall impact.

quotes.speaker: Cam Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Cam Johnson on the team's fast-paced game and overtime execution
quotes.excerpt: It was just a fast-paced game up and down, and kind of just relying on us.
quotes.quote: It was just a fast-paced game up and down, and kind of just relying on us to maybe out-execute a little bit. We didn't really close in the fourth quarter as well as we should have, but at least we did in overtime.
quotes.social_post: Cam Johnson on the overtime win: It was just a fast paced game up and down. We did not really close in the fourth quarter as well as we should have, but at least we did in overtime.

structured.context: Cam Johnson reflects on the fast-paced nature of the game and the team's execution in overtime.

quotes.speaker: Cam Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Cam Johnson on resetting and finishing games
quotes.excerpt: Just settling down and kind of getting back to doing what we do, that's the main thing.
quotes.quote: Just settling down and kind of getting back to doing what we do, that's the main thing. We know what we're capable of. It shouldn't have got to that point in a lot of our opinions, but all we can do in that point is just finish it.
quotes.social_post: Cam Johnson on finishing games: Just settling down and getting back to doing what we do, that is the main thing. It should not have got to that point, but all we can do is just finish it.

structured.context: Cam Johnson discusses the team's mindset regarding the need to reset and finish games more effectively.
